item.title: Marc Anthony Announces YouTube Project: ‘Opus the Recording Session Series’
item.description: Marc Anthony is giving fans an inside look at the making of his Grammy-winning 2019 album Opus. The Latin music powerhouse is set to premiere a YouTube series titled “OPUS the Recording Session Series,” where fans will get a chance to be a fly on the wall witnessing Anthony’s “most intimate journey as a music creator,” according a press release.
